name: alion
description: Live data on millions of companies: funding, tech stack, growth, lookalikes, jobs and pay statistics.

interface.longDescription: Alion is a live graph of companies worldwide, built from the companies' own websites, job boards and public registers. Ask ChatGPT to map a market ("fintech companies in the UAE with 50-200 people that use Kubernetes"), find lookalikes of a company, scout recently funded startups by stage, date or investor, research one company in depth (offices, funding rounds and backers, technology stack, growth and hiring momentum, a dated story of its stages), or answer labour-market questions (pay percentiles, demand, who hires most). Every answer links to the Alion page of each company or posting. Read-only: nothing is created, changed or sent. Short company and job lists are free up to 50 a day; full company profiles, job records and market statistics are paid from your Alion credits.

positive.description: Lookalikes of a known company, with the reasons each one is similar
positive.prompt: Find companies similar to mambu.com and explain what they have in common.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 5-10 companies (e.g. Arcesium, Juniper Square, FIS, Avaloq) with the industry segments and technologies each shares with Mambu, its headquarters country and size, each linked to its Alion page.

positive.description: Recently funded early-stage startups in one country, newest round first
positive.prompt: Which early-stage startups in Germany raised a round in the last year? Show the round and the date.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_companies with funding_stage=early, raised_since=1y, country=DE, sort=recent_funding and lists startups with their last round (seed / series_a) and its date, newest first.

positive.description: One company in depth: funding, investors, stack and growth
positive.prompt: Tell me about finmid.com: funding and investors, tech stack, and how fast it is growing.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves finmid.com and reports what it does, its Berlin headquarters, funding rounds and backers (e.g. Earlybird), the technologies in its postings and its hiring momentum, with a link to its Alion page.

positive.description: A company's open jobs and the full record of one of them
positive.prompt: Show Mambu's open jobs, then the full details of the senior software engineer role.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Mambu's live postings (title, location, work mode, pay estimate) and then the full record of the chosen posting: requirements, technologies, location and its Alion link.

positive.description: Pay and demand statistics for a role in a country
positive.prompt: What do backend engineers earn in Germany, and which companies hire the most of them?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports open postings and hiring companies, the 30-day trend, salary percentiles in USD per year (stated and estimated, with sample sizes), time to fill and the top employers.

negative.description: Asks for a person's private contact details. Alion exposes no personal emails or phone numbers; the assistant should say so and may offer the company page or its public careers information instead.
negative.prompt: Give me the personal email and mobile number of Mambu's CEO.

negative.description: Asks the app to act on the user's behalf. All Alion tools are read-only; the assistant should explain it cannot apply or send anything and may link the job's Alion page where the user can apply.
negative.prompt: Apply to the senior software engineer job at Mambu for me and send my CV.

negative.description: A request unrelated to companies, startups, jobs or markets. The assistant should answer without calling any Alion tool.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Berlin tomorrow?
